ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of white-to-black pixels (approx. 5:95) on the ventral surface; extreme contrast against the near-white background pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black region spanning both lobes. High-intensity white pixels localized in small circular spots (rosettes) and a larger basal patch at the lower center.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression; approximate 60-70 degree angle at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the full length of the trailing edge, characterized by numerous sharp peaks and deep notches of varying pixel depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Lobes sweep upwards and outwards with a distinct concave curvature on the outer margins.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, high-contrast white circular clusters scattered across both lobes, appearing as localized intensity spikes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several sets of parallel white linear streaks (rake marks) are visible; one set is prominent on the inner portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tearing and jaggedness along the entire trailing edge; visible surface rake marks on the ventral plane.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely pronounced and aggressive serration profile across both fluke lobes.
